title: Routine
rubric: The bot created a routine (checked: a new routine with a weekly Monday to Friday schedule at 09:00 exists) whose instruction asks for a one-line weather summary for Berlin. The reply confirms the schedule it set, in plain words, and does not promise anything the routine does not do. The harness never deletes the routine: the orchestrator removes it after the run.
